name: Live & Automated Webinars for WooCommerce and WordPress – WebinarIgnition
author: Saleswonder Team Tobias

sections.description:
WebinarIgnition for WooCommerce lets you run unlimited LIVE WEBINARS, AUTOMATED WEBINARS, and EVERGREEN WEBINARS on WordPress. Sell with WooCommerce, Digistore24, Stripe, or PayPal embedded directly in your webinar room. Display offers, forms, booking, and checkout—no redirects required.

LIVE DEMO WEBINARS

  • For WooCommerce Agencies: Ever Feel Like Every Client Project Starts From Zero?
  • For WooCommerce Shop Owners: Triple Your WooCommerce Sales in Just 30 Minutes
  • Demo Site (Automated & Evergreen Templates): https://demo.webinarignition.com/
  • Meet us: https://webinarignition.com/meet-us/

HIGHLIGHTED BENEFITS

  • WooCommerce checkout inside your webinar (mid-webinar sales)
  • Unlimited webinars and unlimited attendees
  • Unlimited automated and evergreen webinars (run 24/7)
  • Sell webinar tickets and products via WooCommerce, Digistore24, Stripe, PayPal (trial/plus)
  • Timed and manual CTAs: show offers, forms, bookings, or checkout at any moment
  • Any design, any page builder: works with Elementor, Thrive, Gutenberg, etc.
  • Custom registration fields: name, email, participant reason, UTM parameters, and more
  • Built-in GDPR and DACH/EU privacy compliance tools

FREE VS. ULTIMATE PLUS TRIAL (30 DAYS)

FREE VERSION:

  • Unlimited webinars (all types)
  • Unlimited attendees
  • ONE CTA/action per event inside webinar
  • No payment checkout inside webinar (WooCommerce/Digistore24/Stripe/PayPal requires trial/plus)
  • All automated email reminders (confirmation, 1hr before, 1 day before, custom) OR use your own notification service via webhooks
  • Custom registration forms (fields, drag & drop): first name, last name, email, participant reason, UTM parameters, custom fields
  • No import/export/send leads functionality
  • Standard analytics
  • One-click registration (live/auto)
  • Multilingual support (see below)
  • Page builder support with shortcodes/templates
  • WebinarIgnition branding displayed (no white-label)
  • Social registration available via external plugin: Nextend Social Login (free or paid under $50, seamlessly integrated, 22+ providers: Facebook, Google, Instagram, etc.)

30-DAY ULTIMATE PLUS TRIAL:

  • Everything in Free, plus:
  • UNLIMITED CTAs/actions per webinar event
  • WooCommerce/Digistore24/Stripe/PayPal checkout inside webinar with custom triggers/forms
  • Bulk participant import/export with CSV mapping and lead sending
  • Webhooks for CRM/email sync and automations: send all registration data (name, email, reason, UTM parameters) to start your own reminder funnel
  • Full analytics/funnel + exports
  • One-click registration for ALL event types
  • White-label: remove WebinarIgnition branding from admin/host console
  • Built-in 100ms video meetings (external service, seamlessly integrated, up to 10,000 participants, 10K free min/month)
  • Done4U setup service: SMTP, email marketing, video conversion, registration design, streaming provider, hosting, caching
  • Priority support

See all plan details: https://webinarignition.com/#pricing

MULTILINGUAL SUPPORT

Fully translatable and localized. Each webinar can be in a different language with its own date/time format and timezone.
Hand translated: English (us_US), German (de_DE)
Machine-translated: Spanish, French, Italian, Dutch, Portuguese, Russian, Chinese, Hindi, Turkish, Ukrainian, Hungarian, Croatian, Japanese, Urdu (DeepL/Microsoft)
More languages on request (free). All files: /languages/

MAIN FEATURES

  • Unlimited live, evergreen, and automated/paid webinars
  • Registration, participation, and checkout directly in the event (no redirects, trial/plus)
  • WooCommerce/Digistore24/Stripe/PayPal checkout forms and CTAs (trial/plus)
  • Unlimited CTAs/actions, timed offers, forms, polling, and bookings (trial/plus)
  • Full page-builder integration: Elementor, Gutenberg, Thrive, Beaver, Divi, etc.
  • Customizable participant/registration fields: first name, last name, email, participant reason, UTM parameters, custom fields
  • Admin choice: use built-in email notifications OR send all data via webhooks to your external notification service
  • GDPR/DACH/EU, opt-in/consent fields, all data stays on your server
  • Access to 60,000+ WordPress plugins for personalized interactions
  • Social registration via Nextend Social Login plugin (external, seamlessly integrated, free or paid under $50)
  • Video meetings via 100ms service (external, seamlessly integrated, trial/plus includes 10K free minutes/month)

EXTERNAL SERVICES

This plugin may connect to external services depending on your configuration:
– Freemius: licensing/updates/trial management (privacy)
– 100ms Video Meetings: built-in video (trial/plus) (privacy)
– Google APIs: calendar, YouTube Live, Meet (optional) (privacy)
– Stripe: payment processing (optional) (privacy)
– Social Login (Nextend Social Login plugin): Facebook, Google, Instagram, 22+ more (optional/external)
– CDN resources: Bootstrap, Video.js, jQuery, Moment.js, Luxon

No participant data is sent to external services without your explicit configuration.

DOMAIN USAGE DISCLOSURE

WebinarIgnition may connect to:
– freemius.com (licensing, required)
– 100ms.live (video meetings, optional)
– googleapis.com (calendar/YouTube/Meet, optional)
– stripe.com (payments, optional)
– Social login provider domains (optional, via external plugin)
– CDN domains for libraries
sections.installation:
• Download, upload, or install via WordPress Plugins > Add New > WebinarIgnition
  • Activate the plugin
  • Complete onboarding wizard in dashboard (set up your first event)
  • Customize registration, webinar, thank-you, and CTA pages with shortcodes or templates
  • Configure mail delivery (WP or SMTP) OR set up webhooks to use your own notification service
  • Optional: Install Nextend Social Login for social registration (free or paid under $50)
  • Book a free onboarding call or use Done4U setup service (included with Ultimate Plus trial)
sections.faq:
What payment and checkout integrations are supported?

WooCommerce, Digistore24, Stripe, PayPal inside webinar room (trial/plus only). Free version can link to external checkout pages.

Can the design be fully customized?

Yes! Embed registration/events using shortcodes in any WordPress page builder or theme.

How are CTAs and offers shown?

As a sidebar, tab, overlay, direct embed, or timed pop-up (choose for each event).

What languages are built in?

English (hand-translated), German (hand-translated), and 14 machine-translated languages: Spanish, French, Italian, Dutch, Russian, Chinese, Hindi, Turkish, Ukrainian, Portuguese, Urdu, Hungarian, Croatian, Japanese. Request additional languages free via support.

Can each webinar have a different language, timezone, and date format?

Yes. Each webinar can be set to a different language, timezone, and date/time format. All webinar content, registration forms, emails, and even admin settings for that event will display in the selected language and format.

Can I customize registration fields for different webinars?

Yes. Each webinar can have custom registration fields: first name, last name, email, participant reason (why they’re attending), UTM parameters (for tracking marketing campaigns), and additional custom fields. Export this data (trial/plus) to segment attendees in your CRM or email tool.

Can I use my own email notification service instead of built-in reminders?

Yes. Admin can choose to use built-in email notifications OR send all registration data (name, email, reason, UTM parameters, etc.) via webhooks to an external notification service. This lets you start your own reminder funnel in your preferred email marketing platform.

How do I bulk import/export leads?

Free version does not have import/export or lead sending functionality. Trial/Plus allows full mapping and import/export in bulk with CSV files.

What email reminders are included?

All plans include automated email reminders: registration confirmation, 1 hour before, 1 day before, and custom reminder timing. Alternatively, use webhooks to send data to your own notification service.

What is social registration?

Social registration lets attendees register using Facebook, Google, Instagram, and 22+ other providers via the Nextend Social Login plugin (external, seamlessly integrated, free or paid version under $50). Works with all WebinarIgnition versions.

What is Done4U setup service?

Ultimate Plus includes personal technical setup by our team: SMTP configuration, email marketing connection, video source conversion, registration page design, streaming provider setup, unlimited user hosting, and caching optimization.

Can I remove WebinarIgnition branding?

Trial/Plus includes white-label feature to remove branding from admin/host console. Free version displays WebinarIgnition branding.

What is the upgrade path after trial?

Your site keeps Free features; unlimited CTAs, analytics, webhooks, bulk import/export, payment checkout inside webinar, white-label, Done4U setup, etc. require a paid license after 30 days.

Is WebinarIgnition GDPR and privacy compliant?

Yes. All registration and attendee data stays on your WordPress server. Forms include opt-in/consent field and compliance options for EU/DACH.

Can I report security bugs?

Yes. Please report through the Patchstack Vulnerability Disclosure Program.
